method: Private diagnostic AVM1 numerical function queries in real Ruffle, at live UI settings. Not a source-function JS VM. Query calls may update original temporary calculation variables; default static pixels are checked against unmodified bytes. No diagnostic SWF or extracted script is distributed.
scope: Eleven axis samples per queried component, default plus recorded original pointer controls. Unqueried functions, all control combinations, rounded labels and entire displayed curve pixels remain outside this scope.
